name: Puppy Love
source:
A stinky NEET crosses your path...

On one of your many visits to a PC café near home, you meet Nanako Niku - former Counter-Spike pro, current homeless woman. Despite her abrasive personality, she undoubtedly still has the skill of her glory days. And wouldn't you know it, you could really use a coach...
Now she's your roommate?!                                           

With Nanako now under your wing in exchange for high-level coaching, it's up to you to decide her fate. Will you bend to her every whim and enable her terrible habits, or will you stand your ground and help her improve as a person? That's for you to decide!!!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4049790/Puppy_Love/]Steam[/url]]
